summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC furnished a Form 6-K on August 20, 2026, attaching a press release on subcontracts and a supply agreement signed by its subsidiary Al Shola Al Modea Gas Distribution L.L.C. (Al Shola Gas), a unit of Quality Industrial Corp. The release cites aggregate LPG engineering subcontract value of roughly AED 5.14 million ($1.4 million), three new projects worth about AED 4.5 million ($1.24 million), and potential utility revenue of AED 2.95–3.75 million annually. This is an ordinary business-development disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics apply. Watch execution and UAE geopolitical risk.
